# REF-001: Attention Is All You Need

## Citation
Vaswani, Ashish, & Shazeer, Noam (2017). Attention Is All You Need. NeurIPS.

The transformer architecture uses chain-of-thought reasoning and a 7B parameter model.
This is a foundation model survey covering large language model attention.
